## 🔧 Fixed

### First draw for external links in the in-app browser

When a link from another app opens a new browser tab, the first page load now starts after the WebView is attached and laid out. The browser requests a redraw when the page is ready to display and when a cached WebView is reattached. This addresses reports of a blank page until the first tap.

The external link flow was checked on Android 9 and Android 16 emulators on cold start and when returning to the app from the background.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/sametcn99/libredirect-mobile/compare/v1.3.14...v1.3.15)
